# B"H — Sefarim Tests (geelooy/api/sefarim/test/)

Node tests for the Sefarim API (see `../README.md`).

- `sefarimRoute.test.js` — tests both the empty chamber (missing legacy
  Sefarim data) and the filled one, proving the API answers gracefully instead
  of crashing.
